meta.name: give-me-tips
meta.description: Explains any senpi tip in depth - startup tips, working tips, and any Tip: line shown in the TUI (including the Fable-5-refusal fallback tip). Use when the user asks about a Tip: line, says give-me-tips, asks what a tip means, how a tipped feature works, or which tips they can see. Queries the live tip list (senpi --list-tips) first, checks what THIS user can actually see, then verifies the real feature code before explaining.

counter.description: 静态文本估算: CJK 字符 + 拉丁词 + 符号混合计数;不代表任一模型真实 tokenizer。单文本文件 >256KB 或 symlink 逃逸包外的不计入。

copy.tagline: 深入解释任何senpi提示的含义与用法
copy.fit_line: 适合你，如果使用senpi时想弄懂每条提示在说什么
copy.tagline_en: Explain any senpi tip in depth
copy.fit_line_en: For you if you want to understand what each senpi tip means and how to use it

howto.what: 当用户询问某个提示（Tip）时，先运行 senpi --list-tips 获取实时列表，检查该用户实际可见的提示，再阅读对应功能源码，用用户所用语言给出引用具体文件路径的深入解释。
howto.when: 当用户问到某个 Tip: 行、说出“give-me-tips”、或询问提示含义及对应功能原理时触发。

say.text: 这条 Tip: 行是什么意思？
say.note: Claude 会先查实时提示列表再解释。

say.text: give-me-tips，帮我深度解析刚才那条工作提示。
say.note: 会引用源码路径说明机制。

say.text: Fable 5 拒绝后的提示是怎么触发的？

howto.what_en: When the user asks about a senpi tip, it runs `senpi --list-tips` to get the live list, checks which tips this user can actually see (settings, history, command gating), then reads the relevant source code and explains in depth with file path citations, in the user's language.
howto.when_en: Triggered when the user asks about a Tip: line, says 'give-me-tips', or asks what a tip means, how a tipped feature works, or which tips they can see.

say_en.text: What does this Tip: line mean?
say_en.note: Claude queries the live tip list first and explains.

say_en.text: give-me-tips, explain that working tip I just saw in depth.
say_en.note: Cites source file paths for the mechanism.

say_en.text: How is the tip after a Fable 5 refusal triggered?
